proof:
classical
  refine ⟨h_T009, h_T010, ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨ι, hιspec, hιinj, hιrange⟩ := h_T008.2.1.1
    obtain ⟨B⟩ := h_T008.2.1.2.1
    letI : Module.Finite (R p) (MR p M) := Module.Finite.of_basis B
    have hL : (L p M).FG := by
      rw [← hιrange]
      exact Submodule.fg_range ι
    letI : Module.Finite (R p) (L p M) := Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr hL
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := h_T010
    letI : Module.Finite (R p) (Ix l → J p M (ev y v 0)) :=
      Module.Finite.equiv s.symm
    letI : Module.Finite (R p) (J p M (ev y v 0)) :=
      Module.Finite.of_pi (fun _ : Ix l => J p M (ev y v 0)) ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ _⟩
    exact Module.Finite.iff_fg.mp inferInstance
  · intro hJ
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := h_T010
    have hc (c : J p M (ev y v 0)) : (c : ℂ) = 0 := by
      have hc' : (c : ℂ) ∈ (⊥ : Submodule (R p) ℂ) := by
        simpa only [hJ] using c.property
      simpa only [Submodule.mem_bot] using hc'
    have hLzero (u : L p M) : (u : V) = 0 := by
      rw [← s.apply_symm_apply u, hs]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro i hi
      rw [hc]
      exact zero_smul ℂ _
    have hspan : Submodule.span ℂ (M : Set V) = ⊤ := h_T008.2.1.2.2.1
    have htop : (⊤ : Submodule ℂ V) ≤ ⊥ := by
      rw [← hspan]
      apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
      intro m hm
      have hmL : m ∈ L p M := Submodule.subset_span hm
      change m ∈ (⊥ : Submodule ℂ V)
      simpa only [Submodule.mem_bot] using hLzero ⟨m, hmL⟩
    let i : Ix l := ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ _⟩
    have hz : ev y v i.val = 0 := by
      have hz' : ev y v i.val ∈ (⊥ : Submodule ℂ V) := htop (Submodule.mem_top)
      simpa only [Submodule.mem_bot] using hz'
    exact (h_T005.2.1 i).1 hz
